title: Last Week with ChatGPT: A Weibo Study on Social Perspective Regarding ChatGPT for Education and Beyond

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment and topic analysis of Chinese social media (Weibo) posts to identify and evaluate user concerns regarding ChatGPT's misunderstandings and biases toward Chinese culture and society.
Extracting and analyzing user feedback from social media to evaluate public perception regarding the naturalness and accuracy of ChatGPT's Chinese language understanding and generation.
